title: sou350121/VLA-Handbook

title: ginwind/VLA-JEPA
summary: VLA-JEPA targets vision-language-action robot policies by adding a latent world model that predicts future representations rather than raw observations. The project is an ECCV 2026 codebase for experimenting with this JEPA-style predictive objective as a way to improve action learning from visual and language-conditioned context.

It is useful as a map of the rapidly growing VLA/WAM area rather than a runnable tool, helping researchers track relevant papers, methods, and adjacent resources in one place.

title: leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real
summary: PACE targets sim-to-real transfer for legged robots by identifying actuator and joint dynamics using only standard joint encoders, rather than relying on extra sensing or detailed proprietary actuator models. The repo appears useful for making legged-robot simulations better match hardware behavior, especially where unmodeled drivetrain and joint effects are a major source of transfer failure.

extra.full_text: PACE: A systematic approach for sim-to-real transfer of legged robots, identifying actuator and joint dynamics with standard joint encoders.

summary: google-deepmind/mujoco_playground is an open-source library for training robot policies with GPU-accelerated MuJoCo simulation. It is aimed at robot learning workflows where fast simulation and sim-to-real transfer matter, giving researchers a shared playground for developing and testing policies before moving them onto hardware.

title: NVIDIA/warp
summary: NVIDIA Warp is a Python framework for writing GPU-accelerated simulation and computation code, with a clear emphasis on robotics, physics-style workloads, and machine learning pipelines. It is useful when researchers want Python ergonomics while still getting custom high-performance kernels for differentiable simulation, particle systems, geometry processing, or other workloads that need to run efficiently on NVIDIA GPUs.

extra.full_text: A Python framework for GPU-accelerated simulation, robotics, and machine learning.

title: RobotControlStack/robot-control-stack
summary: RobotControlStack is a lean sim-to-real stack for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action models and reinforcement learning agents without ROS. It provides native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution across common robot arms including Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101, and YAM, making it useful for researchers who want a lighter-weight path from simulation experiments to hardware deployment.

extra.full_text: A lean, ROS-free sim-to-real framework for training and deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and RL agents. Native MuJoCo Gymnasium wrappers with synchronous execution for Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101 and YAM.

title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena
summary: Isaac Lab - Arena extends NVIDIA Isaac Lab with a composable system for building robotics simulation environments from interchangeable robots, objects, tasks, and scenes. It is aimed at quickly prototyping robot-learning setups and evaluating policies across diverse embodiments and environments, making it useful for scaling experiments beyond a single hand-built simulator configuration.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.

title: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab
summary: ROBOTIS-GIT/cyclo_lab packages tutorials for training ROBOTIS robots with reinforcement learning and imitation learning, with a path from simulated training to deployment on physical hardware. Its useful focus is Sim2Real: researchers can prototype learned policies in simulation and then move them onto real ROBOTIS platforms rather than treating the repo as simulation-only teaching material.

extra.full_text: This repository provides tutorials for reinforcement learning and imitation learning using ROBOTIS robots, and supports Sim2Real functionality for deploying the learned policies on real robots.

title: D-Robotics/hobot_stereonet

It is aimed at robotics and computer vision systems that need fast 3D perception from stereo cameras rather than heavier or more specialized depth sensors.

title: castacks/AirStack
summary: AirStack is an agent-native robotics stack aimed at moving embodied AI from simulation to real field robots quickly, using a closed-loop workflow that mirrors the target hardware one-to-one. Its emphasis is practical deployment rather than just simulation: the system is designed to self-validate against the hardware path, making it useful for teams trying to shorten sim-to-real iteration cycles for field robotics.

extra.full_text: Agent-native framework for rapid sim-to-real deployment of embodied AI for field robotics. Closed-loop, one-to-one workflow with hardware, self validating. Checkout develop branch for latest features.

title: open-edge-platform/physical-ai-studio
summary: Physical AI Studio provides an end-to-end pipeline for teaching robots from human demonstrations using imitation learning. It is aimed at the practical loop of collecting demonstrations, training policies, and deploying task behavior, making it useful for teams building physical AI systems rather than just experimenting with isolated robot-learning components.

extra.full_text: Physical AI Studio is an end-to-end framework for training robots to perform tasks through imitation learning from human demonstrations.

title: wuji-technology/wuji-mjlab

extra.full_text: In-hand reorientation RL: PPO training and sim-to-real deployment for the Wuji Hand, built on mjlab.

It pairs simulation infrastructure with W&B experiment tracking and is oriented toward sim-to-real transfer, making it useful for testing how learned control policies might illuminate extinct animal movement and inform legged robot design.

extra.full_text: Open-source research platform for dinosaur biomechanics and robotic locomotion using reinforcement learning. MuJoCo-based Gymnasium environments with curriculum learning, W&B experiment tracking, and sim-to-real transfer goals.
